passages.t2-pool: The Westgate pool offers lap swimming from 6 a.m. to 9 a.m. on weekdays. Family swim runs from 1 p.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays. A single visit costs $7 for adults and $4 for seniors. A ten-visit card costs $60 for adults.
passages.t2-branchloans: At the Eastside branch, books can be borrowed for 21 days and DVDs for 7 days. Each card may hold up to 5 items at once. Books can be renewed twice if nobody is waiting for them. Late DVDs are charged 50 cents per day.
passages.t2-ferry: The island ferry leaves the mainland dock at 7:15 a.m., 11:45 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. The crossing takes 35 minutes. Cars must check in 20 minutes before departure. Foot passengers can board until 5 minutes before departure.
